title: Export overview
description: A compact summary of the archive subject, dataset sizes, coverage, and applied redactions.

userId.description: The stable subject identifier for this archive; pseudonymous in AI analysis mode.

preferredLocale.description: The user's preferred BCP 47 locale, if known.

datasetCount.description: The number of datasets described by this overview.

totalRecordCount.description: The sum of record counts across all exported datasets.

datasets.description: Compact summaries of the exported datasets.

recordCount.description: The number of records in the dataset.

path.description: The relative data path inside the archive.

coverage.description: Date coverage and top-level missing-value statistics.

timeStart.description: The earliest recognized record time in ISO 8601 format.

timeEnd.description: The latest recognized record time in ISO 8601 format.

missingValueRate.description: The fraction of top-level record fields whose values are null.

redactions.description: The deterministic privacy transformations applied to the dataset.
